verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any feature for creating a shared team workspace that combines docs and repos into a common source of truth. Related features fall short. CLAUDE.md is a per-project context file read at session start. MCP lets Claude read Google Drive docs within a session. Skills share workflows, not a knowledge workspace. These are adjacent features or would need user-side arrangements (e.g., committing files to git), so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
